name: scholarflow
description: ScholarFlow — scientific publication and conference management system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @scholarflow/api" "npm run dev -w @scholarflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @scholarflow/types && npm run build -w @scholarflow/validation && npm run build -w @scholarflow/ui && npm run build -w @scholarflow/api && npm run build -w @scholarflow/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @scholarflow/types && npm run build -w @scholarflow/validation && npm run build -w @scholarflow/ui && npm run test -w @scholarflow/validation && npm run test -w @scholarflow/api && npm run test -w @scholarflow/web
